died.name: Henry Vane the Younger
died.desc: English politician, statesman and colonial governor

died.last_words: It is a bad cause which cannot bear the words of a dying man.

died.name: Benedict Arnold
died.cause: referring to his Continental Army uniform
died.last_words: Let me die in the old uniform in which I fought my battles for freedom. May God forgive me for putting on any other.
